messages:
Alex: :rotating_light: Found a public gist that includes what looks like a Vault-stored credential referencing a staging path. gist created 1781999000. Not seeing prod indicators yet, but assume compromise until proven otherwise.
Maria: link? paste it and the path please, Ill kick off repo and log checks.
Alex: https://gist.github.com/xxxxxx
Alex: referenced path: secret/data/staging/db/readonly (KV v2). contains base64 blob matching our vault-issuing pattern.
Devon: tagging @samir for immediate infra actions. Samir  can you revoke and rotate?
Samir: doing immediate revokes. commands I ran:
```
vault lease revoke -prefix secret/data/staging/db/readonly
vault token-revoke -self
```
Samir: also started rotation of the GCP service account keys used by the staging DB connector. will confirm when done.
Maria: running quick grep across repos and CI artifacts:
```
rg "secret/data/staging/db/readonly" -S || true
gcloud logging read "jsonPayload.request.headers.*payload:staging" --limit 50
```
Maria: initial repo sweep returned one reference in an old deploy script; opening a PR to remove and scrub artifacts.
Alex: assume anything from that path is compromised. proposed triage: 1) scrub exposed copies (gists, s3, docker images), 2) rotate all creds for that path, 3) tighten RBAC for staging mounts, 4) add detection/alerts for public mentions.
Devon: agree. Im opening an incident (INC-2026). Severity 3 for now. ops-jen can you schedule a short maintenance for connector cutover?
Ops-Jen: I can do a restart at 20:00 UTC; won't affect prod.
Samir: SA key rotation finished. Vault leases revoked. Vault audit tail shows three reads from IP range 54.162.0.0/16 at 1781999500 - not recognized.
Maria: capturing evidence in INC-2026, saving gist screenshots and content hashes. filing takedown request with GitHub support now.
Devon: action items recap:
- Alex: exec comms + legal notification draft
- Maria: repo & logs sweep, contact GH, owner of external takedown
- Samir: confirm full rotation (tokens, SA keys, any long-lived creds)
- Ops-Jen: orchestrate restart and verify connector picks up new creds
- Devon: patch RBAC to remove broad edit roles from staging service group
Samir: note: temporarily disabled automatic key versioning on one SA rotation to avoid tombstone issues; will re-enable post-rotation.
Alex: propose temporary Vault policy lock on the mount to reduce blast radius:
```
path "secret/data/staging/db/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
  allowed_parameters = { "role" = ["connector-role"] }
}
```
Maria: creating the PR for that policy change and linking to INC-2026.
Devon: also schedule audit export for long-term retention and an alert rule: any public URL containing 'secret/data/staging' -> trigger PagerDuty.
Alex: who takes owner of the cleanup sweep across public places (gists, S3 buckets, public docker images)? need someone to run detectors and request removals.
Maria: Ill own the cleanup sweep. plan: run detector across GH/Gist, public S3, Docker hub, and contact platform abuse teams for takedowns.
Alex: ping @security-bot to run automated CI runner token checks.
security-bot: Automated check started: scanning 24 CI runners and artifact caches. Found 1 runner with a cached artifact referencing the staging db path. Artifact removed and runner token invalidated.
Samir: tailing Vault audit logs: no further reads after revokes. good.
Ops-Jen: restart executed at 20:03 UTC, connector picked up rotated creds from new Vault version. monitoring looks stable.
Devon: postmortem owners: Maria (detection & docs), Samir (rotations), Ops-Jen (deploy ops), Alex (communications). initial postmortem draft due in 48 hours.
Maria: filing takedown with GitHub support, included screenshots, hashes, and timestamped evidence in ticket.
Samir: added an audit policy rule to alert on token issuance with TTL > 5m for connector-role to catch longer-lived tokens in future.
Devon: long-term recommendations: enforce KMS-backed encryption on all Vault mounts, enable least-privilege RBAC for service groups, require continuous secret scanning on pushes and artifacts, and add public-mention alerts for high-risk paths.
Alex: downloaded copies of the exposed blob and saved hashes in the incident. will coordinate legal/PR wording: "Potential credential exposure in staging environment. Staging DB credentials rotated; production unaffected. Investigation ongoing."
Maria: takedown request submitted to GH support. saved response thread in INC-2026.
Devon: closing out immediate tasks: rotations complete, cleanup sweep started, policy PR in review. plan a tabletop run of the runbook after PRs merge. thanks all :thumbsup:
